# Parallel

Parallel offers a Task API for automated, structured web research, transforming natural language queries into precise, schema-compliant outputs.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/parallel/.

## Actions

- **Create Task Group**: Create a new task group.
- **Parallel Search** (read-only): Perform parallel semantic search.
- **Retrieve Task Group** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific task group.
- **Stream Task Group Events** (read-only): Stream events for a task group.
- **Suggest Task** (read-only): Suggest tasks based on user or project context.
